entities.name: Juan Carlos Gómez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Carlos Gómez is a Cuban former professional boxer who competed from 1995 to 2014. He held the WBC cruiserweight title from 1998 to 2002, and challenged once for the WBC heavyweight title in 2009.
